## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->

hey-you is a command‑line tool that converts human‑readable time expressions into cron or systemd timer definitions. It lets users create recurring OS‑level tasks with simple phrases like “every monday at 9” without needing to know cron syntax. The tool automatically detects whether the host uses systemd or traditional crontab and writes the appropriate timer or crontab entry. Additional commands allow listing existing timers, explaining existing cron lines, resolving expressions to concrete schedules, and removing tasks. Developers and system administrators benefit from the easy, language‑agnostic way to schedule recurring jobs on any Linux system.
